title: Levenslang leren en competentieontwikkeling
contributors: P van Eldert (Research Centre for Education and the Labour Market (ROA), Maastricht University)
J Allen (Research Centre for Education and the Labour Market (ROA), Maastricht University)
descriptions: In het “SIS Supplement MBO’ers” brengen we in het kader van een leven lang leren de formele en informele leeractiviteiten van schoolverlaters 4 tot 8 jaar na afstuderen in kaart.In the “SIS Supplement MBO’ers” we aim to gain information about the formal and informal learning activities of school leavers 4 to 8 years after graduation in the context of lifelong learning.
